description: Approval declined: binding_echo and client_proof both verify, but the local admin declines — the entire response is PairingResult(201) + Close(201), with no detail anywhere and nothing persisted.
preconditions: QUIC connection with ALPN audio-share/v2; SPKI pin derived from the QR key field verified at the handshake (pairing.md §6.1).
Admission gate: the QR nonce (test-keys.json fixed_randomness.pairing_nonce) is valid, unexpired and unused.
Local approval DECLINED (the admin refuses 'Accept device').
State machine: CONNECTING. Isolated connection; request_id counter starts at 1.
Wire constants are the pairing-happy-path-qr values: binding_echo matches and client_proof is VALID — only the local decision differs from the happy path.

size_bounds.rule: spec §4.2/§10 TM-6: pre-auth responses (pairing/auth refusals included) <= 128 B

assertions: Both proofs verify (binding_echo matches the Client's exporter derivation; client_proof validates against the claimed identity key — the proof inputs are the pairing-happy-path-qr constants): the rejection is purely the declined local approval (spec §5.2), not a proof failure.

PairingResult(201)'s Status carries NO detail field: pre-auth responses never carry detail (spec §4.2/TM-6) — the pre-adjudication 'PairingResult(201, detail "declined")' wording is withdrawn by the 2026-11-12 adjudication.
Approval rejection is exactly PairingResult(201) + Close(201) and nothing else (spec §5.2); the transport close carries 201.

Nothing is persisted: the observable is that no subsequent accept for this identity exists — the authorization store is unchanged, so a later connection authenticating with the same key still receives AuthResult(202) AUTHORIZATION_UNKNOWN (persistence happens only after verified proofs AND approval; spec §5.2, pairing.md §6.3.1/§8).
Both refusal frames are <= 128 B (size_bounds); PairingResponse remains the sole <= 320 B pre-auth exception.

derived.proof_inputs: identical to control.pairing-happy-path-qr (binding_context_qr_hex, proof_input_qr_hex, client_proof); TLV value encodings per pairing.md §6.3 — mode = lowercase ASCII 'qr', protocol_major = fixed 4-byte big-endian (v2 = 00 00 00 02)
derived.persistence_observable: after this exchange, an AuthInit with the same client_public_key yields AuthResult(202) AUTHORIZATION_UNKNOWN — the record was never written
